samples.summary: No test enables the blame gutter at runtime (`setShowAuthors(true)`), which is the only path the toolbar actually uses
samples.evidence: The editor-level tests cover (a) mounting with `showAuthors: false` (line 94-104), (b) mounting with `showAuthors: true` (line 106), and (c) turning it OFF from on (line 123-124). The production path is the opposite direction: notes-detail/notes-view mount with `readShowAuthors()` (default false) and then call `editor.setShowAuthors(true)` when the user checks "Show authors" in the view menu (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-view.tsx effect on `showAuthors`). That direction requires the two compartments to reconfigure, the tracker plugin to be constructed on an existing view, publish labels into `labelsByView`, and schedule the microtask repaint — none of which is asserted anywhere. A regression that leaves the freshly-enabled gutter permanently blank would keep the whole suite green.

samples.summary: MemNoteStore's new authorship-in-undo-state logic (currentState/restore/batch after-state cloning `authors`) has no test
samples.evidence: The diff adds `authors: this.authors.slice()` to `currentState()`, `restore()` and the batch after-state, i.e. undo/redo now must restore authorship alongside text. `packages/notes/src/store/memory.test.ts` has 16 tests (including several undo/redo ones) and contains no occurrence of `author`, `setLocalAuthor` or `getAuthorSpans` (grep returned no matches). `blame-gutter.test.ts` exercises `setLocalAuthor` + `editText` only, never undo/redo. So a bug where undo leaves stale/misaligned author marks (blame pointing at the wrong lines after undo) is entirely uncovered, in a store that is part of the package's public API (exported from packages/notes/src/index.ts).

samples.summary: No test that a remote/peer edit refreshes the gutter labels
samples.evidence: `NoteBlameTracker.update` only recomputes on `update.docChanged`, and remote changes arrive through `noteSync`'s store subscription. The tests only type locally (`view.dispatch({... userEvent: 'input.type' })`, line 143). Nothing asserts that text arriving from a peer (the yorkie-store test proves the spans carry a peer author across the wire, but never that the gutter repaints for it) shows up in the gutter, so the collaborative half of the feature — the actual point of blame — is unverified end to end.
searchedFor: grep subscribeRemote usage in blame tests

samples.summary: The documented ordering invariant (blame gutter left of line numbers; tracker after noteSync) is asserted nowhere
samples.evidence: blame-gutter.ts's header and editor.ts lines 351/385 make extension order load-bearing: the gutter must precede `basicSetup` and the tracker must follow `noteSync`, or the labels are one keystroke stale / on the wrong side. `gutterLabels()` in the test queries `.cm-noteBlame .cm-gutterElement` only, which passes regardless of gutter position relative to `.cm-lineNumbers`. Nothing pins either ordering, so a future reshuffle of the extension array silently breaks it with a green suite.

samples.summary: New preference read/write (readShowAuthors/writeShowAuthors) and the toolbar toggle have no test
samples.evidence: `readShowAuthors`/`writeShowAuthors` (default-false semantics, 'true'/'false' encoding) and the new "Show authors" DropdownMenuCheckboxItem in notes-toolbar.tsx are added with no accompanying test; the only test files under packages/frontend/src/app/notes are yorkie-note-store.test.ts and notes-undo-integration.test.ts (glob), neither of which references showAuthors (repo-wide grep for `showAuthors` lists no frontend test file). The persistence round-trip and the checkbox wiring to `onShowAuthorsChange` are therefore unverified. Note this matches existing practice for viewMode/keymap, which are also untested, so impact is limited.

samples.summary: BlameMarker's hover title and the destroy()/labelsByView cleanup are untested
samples.evidence: `toDOM` sets `span.title = this.label` for elided names and `destroy()` removes the view from `labelsByView`; `gutterLabels()` in the test reads only `textContent`, and no test disposes a view then inspects marker state. Small, but both are new observable behaviors with zero assertions.

verdict.reason: Verified independently: the only `setShowAuthors` call in any test in the repository is `api.setShowAuthors(false)` at packages/notes/src/view/blame-gutter.test.ts:123. Repo-wide case-insensitive grep for `showAuthors|Show authors|show-authors` returns only production code (editor.ts:517-527, notes-view.tsx:155, notes-detail.tsx:47-51, notes-toolbar.tsx:359-364, notes-settings.ts:45-49), the task doc, and four lines in blame-gutter.test.ts (99, 116, 120, 123, 136). A repo-wide grep for `blame` shows blame-gutter.test.ts is the only test file touching this feature; there is no notes-view/notes-detail component test, no e2e directory, and the *.spec.* files are all unrelated backend Nest specs. So the runtime-enable direction — the one notes-view.tsx:155 actually drives when the user checks "Show authors" — is never exercised. That direction is distinct code: editor.ts:517-526 reconfigures the gutter and tracker compartments on a live view, which must construct NoteBlameTracker on an existing view, publish into labelsByView (blame-gutter.ts:128-133, 152-155) and schedule the microtask repaint (164-172). Nothing asserts a label ever appears after enabling at runtime, so a regression leaving the freshly-enabled gutter permanently blank would keep the suite green. Missing test for a changed behavior — squarely in the test-adequacy lane.
